BikkuriMan 2000 - Viva! Festiva!.name: Bikkuriman 2000: Viva! Festival!
BikkuriMan 2000 - Viva! Festiva!.summary: The game is a collection of mini-games. The player selects Sei Tenshi Takeru to move around a park and play the attractions. One of the mini-games is free and can be used to gain coins, with other attractions requiring coins to participate.

Bust-A-Move 4.name: Bust-a-Move 4
Bust-A-Move 4.summary:
Puzzle Bobble 4 (also known as Bust-a-Move 4 in North America and Europe) is the third sequel to the video game Puzzle Bobble and is the final appearance of the series on the Arcade, PlayStation and Dreamcast. The game is also the final title to be recognizably similar in presentation to the original.

Building upon the success of Puzzle Bobble 3, the game adds a pulley system that requires two sets of bubbles, attached to either side of a rope hanging across two pulleys. The game contains a story mode for single player play.

In total, the game features 640 levels. The console version features a level editor to either create and save a level, set a succession of levels, or to create an unlimited amount of extra levels and stages. It also has an alternative "story mode".

TrickStyle.name: TrickStyle
TrickStyle.summary: Grab your board, surf through the air, show your stuff, and win eternal glory with your off-the-chain skills. Re-Live this Dreamcast Classic Today!

Vampire Chronicle for Matching Service.name: Vampire Chronicle For Matching Service
Vampire Chronicle for Matching Service.summary: Released as a mail-order game via Dreamcast Direct, this version allows players to select between four fighting styles based on each Darkstalkers game (the original, Night Warriors, Vampire Savior, Savior 2 and Hunter 2) and features an online versus mode. All characters from previous entries of the Darkstalkers series are included and playable.
